title: "Insufficient calibration" status for G5 native leads to no readings in xDrip
symptom: During the night, the Dexcom receiver alerted for calibration and continued collecting readings, but xDrip stopped collecting readings. There was no alert on the Home screen that calibration was needed; only on the System status page was there an alert for 'insufficient calibration'.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state a root cause, but it is implied that the 'insufficient calibration' status from the G5 native collector prevents xDrip from displaying readings.
fix: Enable the Advanced G5 setting 'Go on without calibrations' to allow readings to continue despite insufficient calibration.
evidence_quote: Can you enable the Advanced G5 setting for `Go on without calibrations` which I think will then allow this.
